title: Analytically unramified local rings and primes
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. The ring $A$ is analytically unramified when its $\mathfrak m$-adic completion $\widehat A=\varprojlim_n A/\mathfrak m^n$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] is reduced, meaning it has no nonzero nilpotent element. A prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subseteq A$ is analytically unramified when the local ring $A/\mathfrak p$, with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m/\mathfrak p$, is analytically unramified.
